# Vendored browser dependencies

- `htmx.min.js`: htmx 2.0.4, Zero-Clause BSD License, <https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx>
- `lucide.min.js`: Lucide 0.468.0, ISC License, <https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide>

These pinned files are served locally so the administration UI does not execute
third-party CDN scripts or require internet access.

The corresponding license texts are distributed from the repository's
`licenses/` directory.
